description_en: Disassociates a network ACL from a vSwitch
description_zh: 调用UnassociateNetworkAcl接口解除网络ACL与交换机的绑定
kebab_example: aliyun vpc unassociate-network-acl --network-acl-id nacl-a2do9e413e0sp0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnassociateNetworkAcl

fields.help_en: The ID of the associated resource to be disassociated
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the associated resource to be disassociated. Valid value: VSwitch (vSwitch).

The value of N ranges from 0 to 29, indicating that you can disassociate a maximum of 30 resources
fields.help_zh:
要解绑的关联资源类型。取值：VSwitch，交换机。

N的取值为0~29，即最多可以解绑30个资源
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The information about the associated resources
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network ACL from which you want to disassociate the resources
parameters.help_zh: 要解绑关联资源的网络ACL的ID
parameters.name: network_acl_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network ACL.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络ACL所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must ensure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to precheck the request. Valid values:
true: prechecks the request.
false (default): sends the request
parameters.help_zh:
是否检测此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run
